reason: The parent contract counted support and query horizons separately but did not distinguish total active training-episode length, literal Liu-v2 presentation length, and the bidirectional query field used only for equivalence qualification.

qualification_query_field.role: A deterministic bidirectional readout field for exact output and intervention comparison; it is not an episode-length claim.

legacy_initial_blank.removal_gate: Both steps must leave P exactly unchanged from zero hidden and eligibility; their hidden and eligibility states are discarded before the first active trial.

successor_constraint: The first no-time direct-training candidate must preserve four support microsteps, two query microsteps, 168--216 active generic-training microsteps, and 56--80 effective P writes per episode. A variable horizon is a separate prospective successor.
